description:
FILED s539c (Opus 5.5, 2026-11-15), member 4 of PPI batch 9 (brief s539/s539c-prompt.md: "take the largest kind whose rows are one tokenizer rule with a perl probe that shows a wrong PCL answer today ... a kind whose rows PCL already compiles right is a checker refinement, not a fix: FILE it").  NO kind qualified: every kind's rows were probed perl -> PCL base (00c6f785) and PCL compiles them right, or they are deliberate non-support.

M0 (tools/ppi-expect-check.pl --population all, on 00c6f785): raw 209 (primary 123), pcl 155 (primary 107).  pcl-mode PRIMARY rows by kind, with the verdict (probe files scratch/s539c/p/k/k1..k7.pl in worktree agent-ade4d9bd1dff36571):

  20 bare-sigil-symbol  Symbol XTERM    signatures.t `sub t010 ($a, $)`: PPI lexes `$)` (Magic); PCL's signature lowering reads the bare placeholder -- k1 SAME.  REFINEMENT: in a signature (XSIGVAR) a bare sigil before `,` / `)` / `=` is the placeholder.
  16 word-after-term    Word XOPERATOR  t/class/*.t (`class`, `field`, `package` after a class block) = ns-class-syntax (DEFERRED), and hexfp.t `p0` after a hex float (Pl::Parser::_preprocess_source rewrites the literal before PPI).  REFINEMENT: the pcl mode should read the preprocessed text; class rows are ns.
  12 brace-class        Structure XOPERATOR  t/class/field.t (ns-class-syntax) + perl-tests/sprintf2.t 752 (a bare block after a block's `}` -- the checker expects a subscript).  REFINEMENT.
  12 cast-then-punct    Operator XCAST  signatures.t `sub t025 ($ = undef)`, `($a, $ = 333)` -- k3 SAME.  REFINEMENT (the same signature placeholder, with a default).
   8 hexfloat-split     Word XOPERATOR  hexfp.t -- preprocessed (as above).
   8 lt-as-comparison   Operator XTERM  coreamp.t / filehandle.t / glob.t `is <$fh>, ...`, `like <file>, ...`, `ok <~>`: `<` after a USER word (Test::More's is / like / ok) -- PCL's lowering repairs it (the after-a-user-sub half of §14 stays PCL's) -- k4 SAME.  REFINEMENT: the checker's pcl mode does not see Parser2's repairs.
   6+3 slash-as-division Operator XTERM / XTERM!  pat.t / pat_advanced.t / pat_re_eval.t / switch.t `ok /(a*b*)(c*)/ && ...`: `/` after a user word -- Parser2::_repair_word_match (§11) -- k5 SAME.  REFINEMENT (as above).
   6 x-as-repetition    Operator XSUBNAME  t/class/*.t `method x { }` = ns-class-syntax.
   4 block-owner-split  Structure XBLOCK  for.t `for CORE::my $var (@l)` -- k7 SAME.  REFINEMENT.
   4 statement-not-ended Word XSTATE  t/class/*.t = ns-class-syntax.
   3 minus-in-number    Number XOPERATOR  `__LINE__ -1`, `__LINE__-1` (Test-Simple plan.t / use_ok.t, coreamp.t): PPI makes Number<-1> after __LINE__ (not in %NO_OPERAND); PCL computes the subtraction -- k6 SAME.  A PPI fix would be cheap (__LINE__ __FILE__ __PACKAGE__ __SUB__ end a term, toke.c FUN0OP / TERM(THING) -- X_CAN_FOLLOW_WORD already lists __SUB__) but no PCL answer is wrong today, so it is not this batch's.
   2 label-not-at-statement-start, 1 brace-class XTERMORDORDOR (base/lex.t 516), 1 punct-name-in-braces, 1 x-as-repetition XTERM (op/goto.t 856 `goto x;` -- FIXED by §66: goto is a builtin that takes an operand).

What a refinement buys: the checker exists to find NEW PPI bugs (docs/ppi-fix-at-source-s527.md §5 point 5); rows PCL already reads right drown a new one.  Two families: (a) the signature placeholder (bare-sigil-symbol + cast-then-punct, 32 rows); (b) the pcl mode is blind to Parser2's word-is-a-term repairs and to _preprocess_source (lt / slash after a user word, hex floats, 25 rows) -- run the pcl mode on the preprocessed text and through Parser2's repairs, or mark those rows by the repair that owns them.  Class-syntax rows: tag them ns-class-syntax.

AFTER (PPI batch 9 tree): see the === s539c AFTER === note below when written.


=== s539c AFTER ===
On the batch tree (rebased over MAIN-READY-95, cc36604b; PPI groups AY AZ BA): raw 209 -> 208 (primary 123 -> 122), pcl 155 -> 154 (primary 107 -> 106) -- the one row that left is x-as-repetition XTERM (op/goto.t 856 `goto x;`, §66: goto takes an operand); every kind above is unchanged; prove tools/t/ppi-expect-check.t PASS (110).
